No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Kings Of Leon Announce 30-City Tour Alongside New Album Release by Bukola Ogunsina 9 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram American rock band Kings of Leon are taking their new album, O My Beloved, on the road with a 30-city North American tour scheduled for 2027.
The tour will open on May 8 in Bristow, Virginia, and conclude on October 15 at New York’s Madison Square Garden. Band of Horses and Dexter and The Moonrocks will join the group as special guests on selected dates.
Released through Love Tap Records and distributed by Virgin Music, O My Beloved is the band’s 10th studio album and first self-produced project. The record features Caleb, Nathan, Jared and Matthew Followill exploring themes of family, gratitude and personal experiences.
The band describes the collection as its most intimate work yet, drawing inspiration from the raw sound of its early musical years in Nashville.
The tour will cover venues across the United States and Canada, including Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Colorado, The Kia Forum in Los Angeles and Toronto’s RBC Amphitheatre.
Spotify’s reserved presale begins November 9, followed by additional artist, Citi and American Express presales on November 10. General ticket sales open on November 13.
